label: Parent follow-up before Build39, not independent review

method.input: Existing visible driver, normal keyboard/mouse and visible HUD/screenshots

observations: Opening Warden, east Interceptor, Heart Warden and nearby Sentinel were eliminated after visible aiming corrections. Final end screen records all four as critical eliminations.
Rifle bursts initially missed the Heart Warden and Sentinel, then corrections onto visible optics killed them. This is pause-assisted aiming, not human precision or enjoyment evidence.

Expanded map stayed visibly in planning after a2300ms wait at00:12 with health100/shield60; it was used again to inspect medical route. This observation supports the intended planning behavior but does not replace lifecycle assertions.
Two cover stops were traversed with actual Space jumps plus forward motion. A later medical wall required sliding to its opening. These are visible obstacles, not evidence of invisible collider bugs.

During focused Interceptor combat shield60 fell to15; during a later Sentinel burst shield39 fell to1. Other attacking sources were hard to identify while aimed at one target. No unjustified damage or tuning defect is inferred.

Parent moved past west reach boundary: distance2.9 became3.2 after a forward step. E did not recover Mara. Parent failed to inspect this result and ran toward extraction with only two memories, then returned and corrected approach. Screenshot mara-recovered.jpg is misleadingly named and actually shows FAILED recovery; mara-confirmed.jpg at00:44 is the actual recovery.
Two Shift activations were visible via cooldown feedback; no phase evades were awarded. This is not evidence of natural phase-break or buffer use.
All three memories were confirmed before final return. Parent entered ring then moved behind a plate; last live capture at00:54 showed100health/47shield and64% upload. Final health is not inferred.

First-person rifle and segmented gloves remain visibly simple. Sustained ADS alignment was not independently measured by this run: the visible driver releases held buttons before capture, so screenshots may depict the exit from ADS. No sight alignment defect is asserted.
nextDecision: Original Blender rifle/glove and first-person handling refinement, with reproducible source/materials, stable ADS inspection and reachable reload articulation; weapon combat values remain unchanged. This planned pass addresses a persistent presentation gap and does not resolve encounter/content depth.
limits: Source-informed paused segmented control, not continuous blind human play.
No independent rating, human enjoyment, audio judgment or hardware performance claim.
One win cannot establish difficulty balance, ideal mission length or AAA readiness.
